Subject: Borealis SIG: Kickoff and CAIQ primer

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We'd like to kick off our SIG/CAIQ intake for Borealis Analytics. Can we schedule a 45-minute primer to review scope, evidence owners, and expected deliverables? Our preferred slots:
- Tue Oct 6, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Oct 7, 11:00–11:45 PT

If those don't work, please propose alternatives. Also, could you share a short CAIQ mapping or guidance doc ahead of the call so our team can prep? We're aiming to align on which artifacts we'll request (logs, backups, key rotation records) and timelines.

Thanks,

Lydia Park

Borealis Analytics
lydia.park@borealis.ai

Hi Lydia — thanks, we'd be glad to run a primer.

Wed Oct 7, 11:00–11:45 PT works for our team. I've penciled that in and will send a calendar invite shortly. I've attached a concise CAIQ mapping template we've used with customers (redwood_caiaq_mapping.xlsx) — it's intentionally short: high-level mapping + sample artifact list.

Quick notes before the call:
- Please identify a single point of contact for evidence collection (name + email).
- If you want us to share a redacted SOC 2 report excerpt or logging sample, we can bring examples to the call.
- We'll ask about retention windows and whether you need on-prem or VPC deployment detail.

cc'ing Marissa (compliance) and Soojin (solutions) who will own evidence coordination and demo/dataflow questions.

Cheers,
